department: School of Physics and Applied Physics

deadline.value: The physics pages do not give an application deadline.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required for every applicant to the Applied Physics PhD.
gre_general.quote: All applicants must submit Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores together with other required application materials

gre_subject.value: The page asks for GRE scores but does not name a subject test.

supervisor.value: The page says research is done under a physics faculty member but does not say whether an agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: Teaching or research assistantships may be available, but the page does not say most students are funded.
funding.quote: Financial assistance may be available in the form of Teaching Assistantships or Research Assistantships

entry_route.value: Applicants need a physics bachelor's with a 3.25 GPA, or a physics master's with a 3.25 graduate GPA.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the Ph.D. in Applied Physics program requires the applicant to have completed either a Bachelor’s degree in Physics (or its equivalent) with a GPA of at least 3.25 or a Master’s degree in Physics

notes: The university offers no plain physics PhD. This is the Ph.D. in Applied Physics (materials, nanoscience, quantum and biomedical physics). The department page links to a graduate catalog page with the same GRE rule.
name: Ph.D. in Applied Physics
